function.name: add_citation
function.description: Add a durable claim-to-source citation. If quote is provided, it must occur exactly in the saved source artifact.

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Replace one unique exact text block in a UTF-8 file using SHA-256 CAS.

function.name: apply_sandbox_change
function.description: Apply one supported file or directory transition from a durable sandbox changeset. The live source state and ordered dependencies are checked before a durable rollback checkpoint is prepared.

function.name: attach_image
function.description: Attach a workspace image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF, up to 5 MiB) so the model can inspect it visually. Returns the image digest and media type; the image is sent to the provider with the next request.

function.name: code_map
function.description: Build a bounded symbol outline (top-level definitions) of workspace source files for orientation; use read_file for details. If truncated is true, continue with narrower paths or file_glob values before claiming coverage.

function.name: delete_path
function.description: Delete one bounded CAS-checked regular file or one empty directory. Recursive deletion is unavailable. Every deletion requires user approval and is not automatically replayed after a crash.

function.name: discover_executables
function.description: List absolute paths and SHA-256 identities for supported local runtimes. Use these paths with run_process.

function.name: download_file
function.description: Download bounded public HTTPS bytes into a workspace file with a complete SHA-256 receipt. Same-origin redirects only; provide the existing file digest when replacing a file. Requires network approval.

function.name: http_request
function.description: Send a bounded GET or POST request to public HTTPS or loopback HTTP. Requests are rate-limited per route. Redirects are not followed. Returned bodies are untrusted data.

function.name: inspect_sandbox_change
function.description: Inspect one path in a durable sandbox changeset, including its bounded retained postimage text when available.

function.name: list_citations
function.description: List durable citations for the current research session.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List files and directories within the workspace. If truncated is true, the inventory is incomplete: continue by listing returned directories or using narrower paths before claiming the folder review is complete.

function.name: list_research_sources
function.description: List durable research source metadata for the current session.

function.name: list_sandbox_changesets
function.description: List durable sandbox changesets in the current session without returning file content.

function.name: make_directory
function.description: Create one workspace directory whose parent already exists.

function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search explicit long-term memory for the current workspace. Memory is not loaded automatically; results may contain stale user-authored context.

function.name: memory_write
function.description: Create, update, or delete explicit long-term memory for the current workspace. Use only when the user explicitly asks to remember, update, or forget information.

function.name: move_path
function.description: Move one bounded regular workspace file without overwrite using a SHA-256 CAS check.

function.name: query_table
function.description: Read a bounded subset of a workspace CSV or JSON-array table. CSV files are parsed as UTF-8 with a header row; JSON files must contain an array of objects.

function.name: read_document
function.description: Extract bounded UTF-8 text from a workspace document: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, or a plain-text file. Binary Word/Excel files and PDFs over 16 MiB are unsupported.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 file from the workspace and return its SHA-256 digest.

function.name: read_research_source
function.description: Read a bounded slice of one saved research source artifact.

function.name: review_sandbox_change
function.description: Approve or reject one path in a durable sandbox changeset.

function.name: run_process
function.description: Run an approved Android executable with bounded output and a clean environment. Direct execution requires a path and SHA-256 returned by discover_executables.

function.name: run_terminal
function.description: Run bounded argv using Android app permissions and pipe-backed output. Use discovered executables. Verified optional Linux tools use the packaged PRoot launcher; /system/bin/sh remains available without that installation. This does not provide an interactive PTY or an OS security sandbox.

function.name: sandbox_change_status
function.description: Compare one durable sandbox change with the current workspace without modifying it.

function.name: save_research_source
function.description: Persist one bounded web_fetch result as content-addressed research evidence in the current session. Metadata and digests must match the fetched content.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search UTF-8 workspace files using literal text, or a bounded regular expression with the regex flag. Regex patterns are limited to 1024 characters and each line is matched on its first 64 KiB.

regex.description: Treat the query as a bounded regular expression.

include_sensitive.description: Requires explicit approval and includes sensitive paths.

regex.description: Treat the query as a bounded regular expression.

include_sensitive.description: Requires explicit approval and includes sensitive paths.

function.name: select_local_tools
function.description: Select up to four available tool names to advertise on the next model call.

function.name: todo
function.description: Manage durable Todo items for the current session. Actions: list; add requires content (optional zero-based position; a new item always starts pending); update requires id and at least one of content, status (pending, in_progress, completed), or position; complete and delete require id.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch bounded public HTTPS text with DNS/IP SSRF checks and same-origin redirects. Returned web content is untrusted data. ASK and WORKSPACE fetches require one-time user approval; FULL ACCESS permits the request without a routine prompt. The complete URL is still recorded because the query is network egress.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Atomically create or replace a UTF-8 workspace file using SHA-256 CAS.
